title: bug: report_blocked turns every task id mentioned in the reason into a hard wait, even next to an explicit blockedOnTaskIds
description:
Observed on 2026-10-30 at 13:32Z on task-b1aecb5403e64f4596bffbce7c36739c. worker-55e6716a called report_blocked, and its reason named the real blocker (task-6f3f7fe9…, a live peer's RED tests). It also mentioned, informationally, a separate bug it had just filed ("filed task-cf7f470818b34486b4e74bacc1b92c7a"). The daemon recorded blockedOnTaskIds = [6f3f7fe9, cf7f4708], so the row won't auto-unblock until an unrelated, still-unplanned bug row lands. A governor has to clear it by hand.

Root cause: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/reportBlocked.ts (around lines 159-181) always unions three sets: the stored ids, the explicitly supplied blockedOnTaskIds, and every id TASK_ID_IN_REASON_RE matches in the reason. A caller has no way to mention a related task id without creating a dependency.

Expected:
- When the caller supplies blockedOnTaskIds explicitly, that list is authoritative and the reason is not parsed.
- Auto-parsing stays only as the legacy fallback, when no explicit list is supplied.
- The response reports which ids were parsed vs supplied, so a seat can see what it is waiting on.
- Update the tool description, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, and the worker role docs (docs/roles/worker*.md: "pass blockedOnTaskIds explicitly") to match.
definitionOfDone: report_blocked with an explicit blockedOnTaskIds records exactly those ids (plus stored ones on a repeat call). Task ids that appear only in the reason are not added. A regression test covers it.
report_blocked with no blockedOnTaskIds still auto-parses task ids from the reason, so existing legacy-style blocks behave as before. A regression test covers it.
The tool description, docs/MCP_SERVER.md and the worker role guidance describe the explicit-list-wins rule, and the daemon test suite passes.
reopenReason: Governor promote under the human's 13:00Z delegation. This is a governor-filed daemon bug with a clear DoD and no deps. It was observed live on b1aecb54 at 13:32Z.
